name: CONSTELLATION BRANDS, INC.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended February 28, 2026 (filed 2026-04-22), EPS note and consolidated statements of operations: 'Weighted average common shares outstanding – diluted' 175.568M for FY2026 (FY2025 181.476M, FY2024 183.959M in the same table). EDGAR companyfacts carries no weighted-share series for CIK 16918 (the filer tags share counts with class dimensions the aggregated facts drop), so the engine filed no share value for any period.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — diluted shares missing for FY2024/2025/2026 (in fact all years) in companyfacts. The filer's own reported FY2026 diluted weighted average count fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period, which leaves the 3-yr median base unchanged (the median of FY24-26 OE/share is the FY2026 figure itself) and is used unprorated by ttm.py as the TTM denominator (vs the H1 FY27 10-Q count of 171.503M — the override denominator is the higher, more conservative one).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 7 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended February 28, 2026 (filed 2026-04-22), EPS note and consolidated statements of operations: 'Weighted average common shares outstanding – diluted' 175.568M for FY2026 (FY2025 181.476M, FY2024 183.959M in the same table). EDGAR companyfacts carries no weighted-share series for CIK 16918 (the filer tags share counts with class dimensions the aggregated facts drop), so the engine filed no share value for any period.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.9x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
